_meta.disclaimer: Panduan ukuran ini adalah estimasi umum Toko Marcell berdasarkan standar Asia/Indonesia dan data ulasan pelanggan. Bukan chart resmi dari brand. Selalu cek detail produk dan ulasan untuk akurasi terbaik.

tops.rule: Jika TB dan BB menunjuk ke dua ukuran berbeda, prioritaskan lingkar dada/bahu.

bottoms.description: Standard Bottoms — Waist Sizing (Inches to Centimeters)

brand_offsets._note: Data-driven corrections from 3.36M reviews (pipelines/build_fit_signals.py). Values override generic baseline assumptions from the original size_charts.md.

Dickies.offset_note: Runs 1–2 sizes smaller than standard denim. Non-stretch 8.5 oz twill, sits at natural waist.
Dickies.action: Size up 1–2 inches from standard jeans size. For oversized/baggy look, size up 2.

Levi's.offset_note: True to American denim size. Cut varies by model: 501 = straight/button-fly, 505 = roomier seat/thigh/zip. Truckers are snug in shoulders — size up 1 for layering.
Levi's.action: Order standard size. For 501 vs 505, recommend 505 for athletic/muscular thighs.

Carhartt.offset_note: Slightly roomier than standard but NOT a full size large. US workwear cut with moderate shoulder drop. Data shows near-balanced fit, leaning marginally large.
Carhartt.action: Order standard size for a comfortable workwear fit. Only size down if you want a slim/fitted look.

Champion.offset_note: NOT runs large as commonly assumed. Data shows Champion actually leans slightly small (25.4% small vs 19.5% large). Standard US athletic cut.
Champion.action: Order standard size. If between sizes, consider sizing up rather than down.

Birkenstock.offset_note: European sizing with contoured cork-latex footbed. Toes and heels must sit within the rim. If between sizes, size down.
Birkenstock.action: Use foot length in cm or EU size. If between sizes (e.g., 41.5), take EU 41. Break-in period 7–10 days.

TOMS.offset_note: True to US size. Canvas stretches slightly after 3–5 wears. Data shows near-balanced with slight small lean.
TOMS.action: Order standard size. For wide feet or wearing with socks, consider half size up.
